q: Can free cooling cut chiller electricity in a factory?
title: Free cooling for process chillers
short: Yes, when outside air or cooling tower water is colder than the return water you need. In cooler months or at night, a free cooling heat exchanger can carry part or all of the load with only pumps and fans running. Measure chiller kWh before and after over the same season.
audience: Plastics, pharma and food plants with process chillers

ul: Process water needed above about 15 C.
Sites with cool nights or winters.

p: Log chiller and pump kWh and outside temperature. Compare like months, or normalise with degree days.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel invoices and electricity bills and applies IPCC 2006 factors and the CEA grid factor (0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25), so you can compare Scope 1 and 2 before and after a change from the documents themselves.
